question: Who took the most wickets (205) in IPL history before IPL 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yuzvendra Chahal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Yuzvendra Chahal** holds the record for the highest number of wickets in the history of the **Indian Premier League (IPL)**, standing at **205 wickets** before the commencement of the **IPL 2025** season.
 
• He reached the monumental milestone of **200 wickets** during the **2024** season while playing for the **Rajasthan Royals** in a match against the **Mumbai Indians**.
 
• By the end of the **IPL 2024** edition, he had played **160 matches**, maintaining an impressive bowling average and becoming the first-ever player to cross the double-century mark in terms of wickets in this tournament.
 
• He surpassed the previous long-standing record held by the **West Indian** all-rounder **Dwayne Bravo**, who retired with **183 wickets** in the league.
 
• His performance in the **2024** season included taking **18 wickets** in **15 matches**, which cemented his position at the top of the all-time leaderboard.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Career Trajectory:**
 
 
• **Yuzvendra Chahal** started his **IPL** career with the **Mumbai Indians** in **2011**, but he became a household name during his tenure with **Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB)** from **2014** to **2021**.
 
• In the **2022 Mega Auction**, he was signed by the **Rajasthan Royals** for **Rs. 6.5 crore**, where he immediately made an impact by winning the **Purple Cap** in **2022** with **27 wickets**.
 
 
 
• **Top Wicket-Takers Leaderboard:**
 
 
• As of the end of the **2024** season, the top wicket-takers following **Chahal** (**205**) are **Piyush Chawla** (**192 wickets**), **Dwayne Bravo** (**183 wickets**), **Bhuvneshwar Kumar** (**181 wickets**), and **Sunil Narine** (**180 wickets**).
 
• This highlights the dominance of spin bowlers in the historical rankings of the tournament.
 
 
 
• **International Standing:**
 
 
• Besides his **IPL** success, **Chahal** is also the leading wicket-taker for **India** in **T20 Internationals (T20Is)**, proving his consistency across the shortest format of the game at both domestic and international levels.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Options Analysis:**
 
 
• **Jasprit Bumrah**: A premier fast bowler for **Mumbai Indians**, he has taken **165 wickets** in **133 matches** as of **2024**. Although he is one of the most successful pacers, his tally is currently lower than **Chahal's**.
 
• **Arshdeep Singh**: He is a young left-arm pacer playing for **Punjab Kings**. By the end of **2024**, he has **76 wickets** in **65 matches**, making him a rising star but far from the all-time record.
 
• **Prasidh Krishna**: He has represented **Kolkata Knight Riders** and **Rajasthan Royals**. With **49 wickets** in **51 matches**, he has significantly fewer wickets compared to the veterans of the league.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the 205 mark:**
 
 
• The **205 wickets** milestone reached by **Chahal** represents over a decade of high-level performance, during which he has played for three different franchises: **Mumbai Indians**, **RCB**, and **Rajasthan Royals**.
